I couldn't find a name for Kwame's night-dispatch contact at Driftmoor. I checked everything you can see: #coastal-team, #coastal-random, #general, #help-it-ops, our DM thread, and the shared Coastal notes and digests.

All I found is a line in the Coastal cheat sheet. It says Driftmoor Marine Freight got a manual CSV patch from engineering for "the night dispatcher", with no name or email.

I'm not going to guess an address. Kwame runs the account, so he's the quickest person to ask. If you do email the contact, it will go outside pemberline.com. That needs Ruth Calloway's approval, even as a draft. Once you have the name, tell me and I'll request that approval for you.
